name: Kijun Sen Robot
summary: This EA trades based on the Kijun Sen line from the Ichimoku Kinko Hyo indicator, entering positions when price crosses the Kijun Sen and exiting based on opposite crosses or stop loss/take profit levels. It is a systematic trend-following system that uses the Ichimoku cloud component as its core signal generator for both entries and exits.
summary_zh: 该EA基于一目均衡表的基准线(Kijun Sen)进行交易,当价格穿越基准线时入场,在反向穿越或触及止损/止盈时出场。它是一个系统化的趋势跟踪策略,使用一目均衡表组件作为核心信号生成器来决定入场和出场。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是利用一目均衡表的基准线(Kijun Sen)作为趋势判断和交易信号的基础。入场条件为价格从下方穿越Kijun Sen时做多,价格从上方穿越Kijun Sen时做空,这种穿越代表了趋势方向的可能转变。出场条件包括价格反向穿越Kijun Sen、达到预设的止盈目标或触发止损保护。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于账户资金的百分比计算方式。资金管理方面,EA通过止损来控制单笔交易风险,但具体的风险控制力度取决于参数设置。整体策略逻辑简洁明了,属于典型的趋势跟踪类系统,但缺乏对市场震荡行情的过滤机制,容易在盘整市中产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is using the Kijun Sen line from the Ichimoku indicator as the foundation for trend determination and trading signals. Entry conditions are triggered when price crosses above the Kijun Sen for a buy signal and crosses below for a sell signal, representing a potential shift in trend direction. Exit conditions include price crossing back in the opposite direction across the Kijun Sen, reaching a predefined take profit target, or hitting the stop loss level. Position sizing typically employs either fixed lot sizes or a percentage-based calculation relative to account equity. Money management relies on stop losses to control per-trade risk, though the effectiveness of risk control depends heavily on the specific parameter settings. The overall strategy logic is clean and straightforward, characteristic of a trend-following system, but it lacks a ranging market filter which can lead to frequent false signals and consecutive losses during choppy consolidation periods.

pros: 策略逻辑简洁清晰,基于成熟的Ichimoku指标,易于理解和维护
使用Kijun Sen作为动态支撑阻力,比固定止损更能适应市场波动
具备止损止盈和移动止损功能,有基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Strategy logic is clean and straightforward, based on the well-established Ichimoku indicator, making it easy to understand and maintain
Uses Kijun Sen as dynamic support/resistance, adapting better to market volatility than fixed stop levels
Includes stop loss, take profit, and trailing stop functionality, providing a basic risk control framework
cons: 缺乏震荡市场过滤机制,在盘整行情中容易产生大量假信号导致连续亏损
单靠Kijun Sen穿越作为信号过于单一,没有结合Tenkan Sen或云层等其他Ichimoku组件进行确认
缺少新K线检测机制,可能在同一根K线上重复开仓,导致不必要的多重仓位
cons_en: Lacks a ranging market filter, prone to generating numerous false signals and consecutive losses during consolidation periods
Relying solely on Kijun Sen crossover as a signal is overly simplistic, without confirmation from other Ichimoku components like Tenkan Sen or the cloud
Missing new bar detection mechanism, potentially leading to repeated entries on the same bar and unintended multiple positions
improvements: 增加Tenkan Sen/Kijun Sen交叉或云层位置作为信号确认条件,减少假信号
加入ADX或波动率过滤器来识别震荡行情,在低趋势强度时暂停交易
实现新K线检测逻辑,确保每个信号只交易一次,避免同一K线重复开仓
improvements_en: Add Tenkan Sen/Kijun Sen crossover or cloud position as signal confirmation to reduce false signals
Incorporate an ADX or volatility filter to identify ranging markets and pause trading during low trend strength periods
Implement new bar detection logic to ensure each signal is traded only once, preventing duplicate entries on the same bar

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查可能导致同一K线上多次开仓,增加风险敞口
单一指标信号在震荡市中容易连续止损,造成资金回撤
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause multiple entries on the same bar, increasing risk exposure
Single indicator signals in ranging markets can lead to consecutive stop losses and significant drawdown

It is a systematic trend-following system that uses the Ichimoku cloud component as its core signal generator for both entries and exits.
